summary: The vanilla HTML/JS frontend implementation meets all requirements. It provides a clean chat interface, properly communicates with the backend via Fetch API, and displays results with similarity scores. No external frameworks are used.

notes: index.html is served at GET / via serve_frontend() in main.py
Chat interface has query input field and submit button
Fetch API correctly used to POST to /query endpoint
Results displayed with text content and similarity percentages
Loading state shown during query with spinner animation
Error handling implemented for failed requests
Pure vanilla JavaScript with no framework dependencies
Clean, modern UI with responsive design
Proper event handling for Enter key and button click
Status bar shows API connection status, chunk count, and dimensions
Similarity badges color-coded by match quality (green/orange/red)
Integration with backend verified through API tests
